execution_request_id different request_fingerprint_sha256',approved_for_merge:false,merge_performed:false}}];}}for(const payload of evidencePayloads){const same=payload.execution_request_id===request.execution_request_id&&payload.request_fingerprint_sha256===request.request_fingerprint_sha256;const terminal=Boolean(payload.implementation_commit_sha||payload.pr_number||payload.pr_url||payload.pr_head_sha);if(same&&terminal)return[{json:{...request,resolution:'return_existing_result',existing_result:payload,approved_for_merge:false,merge_performed:false}}];}for(const item of checkpointItems){const output=parsePayload((item.json||{}).output_json)||{};const input=parsePayload((item.json||{}).input_json)||{};const checkpoint=Boolean(output.implementation_commit_sha||output.pr_number||output.pr_url||output.pr_head_sha);if(same&&checkpoint)return[{json:{...request,resolution:'resume_or_return_existing_result',existing_result:output,approved_for_merge:false,merge_performed:false}}];}return[{json:{...request,resolution:'proceed_new_execution',existing_result:null,request_fingerprint_sha256:request.request_fingerprint_sha256,approved_for_merge:false,merge_performed:false}}];
